description: This source file contains utility functions used for testing purposes within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for checking external dependencies like Azure Storage, Event Hub, and Redis, as well as timing and concurrency utilities for performance measurement, and context management utilities.

classes.name: TestUtils
classes.description: A static class providing various utility methods for testing, including environment checks, performance calibration, and utility functions.

classes.name: RequestContextTestUtils
classes.description: A static utility class for managing request activity IDs within test scenarios.

methods.name: GetRandomGrainId
methods.description: Returns a random grain identifier using shared random number generator.

methods.name: CheckForAzureStorage
methods.description: Checks Azure Storage connection strings and starts the storage emulator if necessary.

methods.name: CheckForEventHub
methods.description: Verifies Event Hub connection string availability and enforces TLS version.

methods.name: CheckForRedis
methods.description: Ensures Redis connection string is set.

methods.name: ForceTlsVersion
methods.description: Enforces the use of TLS 1.2 protocol for network security.

methods.name: CalibrateTimings
methods.description: Performs a timing calibration by measuring an empty loop execution time.

methods.name: TimeRunAsync
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous action, measures execution time, and logs memory consumption and timing delta against baseline.

methods.name: ConfigureClientThreadPoolSettingsForStorageTests
methods.description: Configures thread pool and service point manager settings for storage-related tests.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Retrieves activation counts for a specified grain type via management grain.
